2026-11-26.overview: Crown Prince Wu Luan is in love with Little Wan but left heartbroken when she marries his father, the emperor. The emperor's brother, Li, kills him and Wu Luan tries to avenge his father's death.

2026-11-26.title: Rumble in the Bronx

One of those petty thugs in the local gang stumbles into a criminal situation way over his head.

2026-11-26.title: Dreadnaught

2026-11-26.title: Once Upon a Time in High School
